import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib

print(f"Titer > 20: {(df['ProductTiter']>20).sum()}")
print(f"Titer bins:")
print(pd.cut(df['ProductTiter'], bins=10).value_counts().sort_index())

print("\n=== DO distribution ===")
print(pd.cut(df['DissolvedOxygen'], bins=10).value_counts().sort_index())

print("\n=== VCD distribution ===")
print(pd.cut(df['ViableCellDensity'], bins=10).value_counts().sort_index())

# Are DO and VCD essentially measuring the same thing?
slope, inter, r, p, se = stats.linregress(df['DissolvedOxygen'], df['ViableCellDensity'])
print(f"\nDO vs VCD regression: slope={slope:.3f}, intercept={inter:.3f}, r={r:.3f}, p={p:.2e}")
print(f"DO range: {df['DissolvedOxygen'].min():.1f} - {df['DissolvedOxygen'].max():.1f}")
print(f"VCD range: {df['ViableCellDensity'].min():.1f} - {df['ViableCellDensity'].max():.1f}")

# Partial correlation: is VCD-titer correlation driven by DO?

print(f"\nVCD residual (after removing DO) vs Titer: r={r_resid:.3f}, p={p_resid:.4f}")

# Partial correlation: is DO-titer driven by VCD?
slope2, inter2, r2, p2, se2 = stats.linregress(df['ViableCellDensity'], df['DissolvedOxygen'])

print(f"DO residual (after removing VCD) vs Titer: r={r_do_resid:.3f}, p={p_do_resid:.4f}")

# Multiple regression: DO + VCD predicting titer
from numpy.linalg import lstsq
X = np.column_stack([df['DissolvedOxygen'], df['ViableCellDensity'], np.ones(len(df))])
coefs, residuals, rank, sv = lstsq(X, df['ProductTiter'], rcond=None)
print(f"\nMultiple regression DO+VCD -> Titer:")
print(f"  coef DO={coefs[0]:.3f}, coef VCD={coefs[1]:.3f}, intercept={coefs[2]:.3f}")
pred = X @ coefs
ss_res = np.sum((df['ProductTiter'] - pred)**2)
ss_tot = np.sum((df['ProductTiter'] - df['ProductTiter'].mean())**2)
print(f"  R²={1-ss_res/ss_tot:.3f}")

# Look for threshold effects
print("\n=== Titer by DO quartile ===")
df['DO_q'] = pd.qcut(df['DissolvedOxygen'], 4, labels=['Q1','Q2','Q3','Q4'])
